blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday said the Chinese government would provide $20 million to support cooperation efforts in the Asia-Pacific region. In his opening statement at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting here, Xi reaffirmed China’s support for Apec member economies as they convened for the annual forum.
